title: Future continuous and future perfect: guided practice
titleEs: Futuro continuo y futuro perfecto: práctica guiada
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: This time next week, we ___ on the beach.
items.explanationEs: Algo en curso en un momento del futuro: will be + verbo con -ing.

items.prompt: By the end of the year, I ___ my degree.
items.explanationEs: Terminado antes de un momento del futuro: will have + participio. Will no cambia: nunca will has.

items.statement: Don't call me at nine: I'll be having dinner.
items.explanationEs: A las nueve estaré cenando: will be + -ing.

items.statement: By 2030, scientists will have find a cure.
items.explanationEs: Después de will have, el participio: will have found.

answers: Will you be using the car tonight?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta: will + sujeto + be + verbo con -ing.

answers: They won't have arrived by noon.
